div.head: Af 12
div.ab: XIII. Gif mon oþres wudu bærneð oþþe heaweþ unalyfedne, forgylde ælc great treow mid V scll', ond siþþan ælc, swa monig swa þær sy, mid V peningum; ⁊ XXX scll' to wite.
XIII. Gif mon oðres wudu bærneð oððe heaweð unaliefedne, forgielde ælc great treow mid V scill., ⁊ siððan æghwylc, sie swa fela swa hiora sie, mid V pæningum; ⁊ XXX scill. to wite.

Si quis nemus alterius sine licentia comburat uel taliet, soluat omne grossum lignum quinque solidis, deinceps omne, quotquot sint, quinque denariis restituat, et triginta sol. wite, id est forisfacti.
{XIII} Gif mon oðres wudu bærneð, oððe heaweð unaliefedne, forgielde ælc great treow mid scill, ⁊ siððan æghwylc, sie swa fela swa hiora sie, mid V pæningim; ⁊ XXX scill to wite.

If a someone burns another’s wood or cuts it down without permission, let him compensate for each large tree with 5 shillings, and afterwards each [smaller tree], however many there may be, with 5 pennies; and 30 shillings as fine.

If one man burns or fells the trees of another, without permission [to do so], he shall pay 5 shillings for each big tree, and 5 pence for each of the rest, however many there may be; and [he shall pay] 30 shillings as a fine.

If a man burns or fells the wood of another, without permission, he is to pay for each large tree with five shillings, and afterwards for each, no matter how many there are, with fivepence; and 30 shillings as a fine.

Wenn jemand das Gehölz eines anderen ohne Erlaubniss abbrennt oder abhaut, so vergelte er jeden grossen Baum mit 5 Schill., und weiterhin jeden, sei es so viele als ihrer seien, mit 5 Pfennigen; und 30 Schill. zur Strafe.

If someone burns or cuts down another’s woodland without permission, let him pay for each large tree with 5 shillings, and after that for each one, however many of them there may be, with 5 pence; and 30 shillings as a fine.

note.label: contradicts
note.quote: there are differences in the sums levied for ... felling another's trees (n. 72: Af 12, Ine 43:1)

note.label: emends
note.quote: Ine §44 stipulates that a man must pay 30 shillings for each of the first three trees [...] Alfred §14 requires only a 5-shilling payment

note.label: contrast
note.quote: Contrast with Ine §44 where different fines are established for felling or burning another's wood. These clauses suggest that Ine's laws were [...] superseded
